Population increased in North Devon

The estimated population of North Devon in 2024 was 101,222 usual residents, a rise of 0.6% since 2023.

This meant that North Devon's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of North Devon increased by 1.8%.

Over this slightly longer period, North Devon was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of North Devon

The average (median) age fell to 48.6 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of North Devon has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
North Devon is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, North Devon's population of 101,222 usual residents was made up of:

  • 16,449 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.3%)
  • 57,972 people aged 16 to 64 years, (57.3%)
  • 26,801 people aged 65 years and over, (26.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, North Devon has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (26.5% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In North Devon, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in North Devon
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for North Devon, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 547 people (-0.5%). In total, there were 751 births and 1,298 deaths in North Devon.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 760 (0.8%). There were 5,350 people entering the area and 4,590 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in North Devon's population of 350 (0.3%) as a result of 555 people entering the area and 205 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for North Devon was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of North Devon in mid-2023 is 100,664.

Within this, international migration was revised downwards by 54 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 175 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 121 people.
